slots.label: Paragraph 1
slots.default: Not covered here? Ask us directly — same working day response.

slots.label: Paragraph 2
slots.default: Penetration testing is an authorised, simulated attack on your systems that safely uncovers exploitable weaknesses, external, internal, cloud and application, so you can fix them before a real attacker finds them.

slots.label: Question 2
slots.default: How often should we run a penetration test?

slots.label: Paragraph 3
slots.default: Most businesses test at least annually, and after any significant change such as a migration, new application or office move. We’ll help you set a cadence that matches your risk profile and compliance needs.

slots.label: Paragraph 4
slots.default: No. Testing is carefully scoped and scheduled around your operations. Our goal is to surface risk safely, without impacting your team or your customers.

slots.label: Question 4
slots.default: What do we get at the end?

slots.label: Paragraph 5
slots.default: A clear report written in plain English, with findings prioritised by business impact and practical, step-by-step remediation guidance your team can act on, plus support to help you close the gaps.
